ge.wd1: English comedy at Flanagans on Thursday and the queer film festival at the Grütli round off the week.
ge.we1: Musée Ariana's ceramics show and the last weekend of Everybody's Perfect; rain likely Sat and Sun, so plan indoors.
ge.wd2: A busy social week: English stand-up in Lausanne on Tuesday, and pub philosophy or Social Hour on Wednesday.
ge.we2: Plainpalais and Rive flea markets and the free market in Haute-Savoie on Saturday.

zh.wd1: English stand-up at ROBIN's Coffee and a Halloween pottery workshop on Thursday.
zh.we1: English comedy at Les Amis in Bern on Friday, the Photobastei show and Züri-Wiesn; rain likely Sat and Sun, so indoor plans win.
zh.wd2: Creative Tuesday: a watercolour card workshop, life drawing in Lucerne, or WOMXN ON STAGE.
zh.we2: Pumpkin painting at House of Craft on Sunday, speed friending on Saturday and Expat Friday at Club Bellevue.

picks.why: Marie Ducaté's colourful glass and ceramics at Musée Ariana; a perfect indoor plan for a rainy day.
Last weekend of the queer film festival at the Grütli; many films with English subtitles, party nights too.
Geneva's big flea market at Plainpalais; go early, and bring an umbrella as rain is likely.
Friendly, free discussion group in English at the Crowned Eagle pub near Cornavin.
Social Circle drinks and games at Casa Tiki; free tickets, book ahead (ages 22–35).
Free English stand-up night in Lausanne where pros test new material; about 45 min by train.
Monthly English stand-up showcase at Les Amis in Bern, about an hour from Zurich; free entry.
Thought-provoking photo exhibition on migration and images at the Photobastei; good indoor option.
Phone-free journaling and creative evening at Paint it Easy; relaxed way to meet people. Free, ticket needed.
Oktoberfest under the roof of Zurich main station: beer tent, music and food, rain or shine.
Free hands-on watercolour session making personalised cards; materials provided, ticket needed.
Free life-drawing session with live models in Lucerne for anyone who likes drawing or painting.
Kunsthaus and Opernhaus team up for an evening on what lingers after art and music, at the Chipperfield building.

a-ge-quiz-night-tables-for-singles-by-so.desc: Social Circle x Tinder pub quiz for ages 22–35, with tables set aside for singles. Free, but you need a ticket from social-circle.ch.

a-ge-simultane-s-10-17.desc: Exhibition of French artist Marie Ducaté's playful glass, ceramics and painted works at Musée Ariana, Geneva's museum of ceramics and glass.

a-ge-marche-aux-puces-brocante-de-plainp.desc: One of Switzerland's largest flea markets: vintage, furniture, books, records and bric-a-brac on the Plaine de Plainpalais. Best early in the morning.

a-ge-date-my-friend-ages-25-37-in-englis.desc: Comedy-style matchmaking evening in English where friends present each other to the room. Ages 25–37; about CHF 10.

a-ge-pub-philosophy-in-english-10-21.desc: Open, friendly philosophy discussion in English, every other Wednesday in the downstairs room of the Crowned Eagle pub. Free, no background needed.

a-ge-social-hour-drinks-games-good-vibes.desc: Relaxed Social Circle drinks with icebreaker games at Casa Tiki for ages 22–35. 50 free tickets; book on social-circle.ch.

a-ge-tuesday-but-funny-english-comedy-10.desc: Free English-language stand-up in Lausanne where professional comedians try new jokes and newcomers do their first sets.

a-zh-bear-pit-comedy-english-stand-up-mo.desc: Monthly English stand-up showcase at Les Amis bar in Bern, with comedians from across Switzerland. Free entry.

a-zh-bilder-schaffen-wirklichkeit-10-17.desc: Photo exhibition at the Photobastei exploring how images shape our view of migration. Open until 25 October.

a-zh-digital-detox-cafe-10-18.desc: Social Circle's phone-free café evening at Paint it Easy, with journaling and creative prompts. Free, but a ticket is needed.

a-zh-20-zu-ri-wiesn-unser-oktoberfest-im.desc: Zurich's Oktoberfest inside the main station: a two-storey beer tent, Bavarian food and live music.

a-zh-watercolor-workshop-10-20.desc: Beginner-friendly watercolour workshop making personalised cards at Quartierhaus Kreis 6. Free, ticket needed via social-circle.ch.

a-zh-kunstakt-at-f-iz-luzern-10-20.desc: Open life-drawing group in Lucerne for anyone who enjoys drawing or painting from live models.

a-zh-nachhall-10-20.desc: Talk series by Kunsthaus Zürich and Opernhaus Zürich on what stays with us after art and music; likely in German.

a-ge-puces-de-la-couture-10-17.desc: Sewing flea market in Bellegarde: fabric, haberdashery, patterns and sewing gear sold by locals. Free entry.

a-ge-sylvia-sleigh-10-17.desc: Retrospective of British-born painter Sylvia Sleigh, known for her feminist figurative portraits. Final weeks at Musée Rath.

a-ge-observatoires-10-17.desc: Artist John M Armleder's carte blanche at the Museum of Art and History, remixing the collection. Ends 25 October.

a-ge-graines-en-fe-te-10-18.desc: Free afternoon at the Botanical Garden celebrating 25 years of its seed bank, with displays on seed diversity. Dog-friendly gardens.

a-ge-improv-comedy-fairytale-happily-eve.desc: A fully improvised fairytale show at the Impro Comedy Club; check the listing for the language. Free.

a-ge-guitars-and-friends-festival-10-17.desc: Three-day festival in Nyon's communal hall with acoustic concerts, songwriting masterclasses and jam sessions.

a-zh-pedro-rodrgues-go-anywhere-do-anyth.desc: Opening show of the new spicy art space in Burgdorf: a multimedia exhibition by Pedro Rodrigues.

a-zh-womxn-on-stage-10-20.desc: Social Circle's open stage showcasing women and non-binary performers at Amboss Rampe. Free, ticket needed.

add.title: Everybody's Perfect — Geneva Queer Film Festival
add.place: Maison des arts du Grütli, Rue du Général-Dufour 16, Genève
add.desc: Geneva's international LGBTIQ+ film festival: ten days of features and shorts at the Cinémas du Grütli, plus talks, performances, workshops and party nights. Many films have English subtitles. Programme and tickets on everybodysperfect.ch.
